SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.definition: Experiment or observation outcome aligns with falsifiable_expectation within declared tolerance
SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.effect_on_belief: May move PROPOSED/WEAKENED → SUPPORTED; may strengthen ordinal balance

DISCONFIRMING_EVIDENCE.definition: Outcome crosses disconfirming_observation_spec threshold or favors null_competing_explanation
DISCONFIRMING_EVIDENCE.effect_on_belief: May move → WEAKENED or FALSIFIED depending on severity

CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE.definition: Two or more valid evidence events of comparable quality point in opposing directions
CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE.note: Distinct from single disconfirming event — both sides may be valid

NON_INFORMATIVE_EVIDENCE.definition: Experiment executed correctly but does not meaningfully resolve the uncertainty
examples: flat quintile ordering within noise band
NON_INFORMATIVE_EVIDENCE.effect_on_belief: → UNRESOLVED or no change; must NOT count as support

INVALID_EVIDENCE.definition: Leakage, execution failure, insufficient sample, grammar violation, or invalid comparison
INVALID_EVIDENCE.effect_on_belief: Excluded from belief update; logged with exclusion reason
